notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage to Phyrexian Vindicator is prevented, triggering Phyrexian Vindicator, dealing 100 damage to any target.
